provenance.method: Exact finite Gaussian and Schur elimination; specified shifted radial-cutoff phi4 bubble and independently checked subtraction/RG.

scope.bubble: Feynman parameter first, shifted Euclidean radial cutoff; regulator choice is part of the definition.
scope.vertex: Three equal off-shell Euclidean channel invariants Q^2, through O(g_R^2); not a scattering observable.
scope.rg: Mass-independent MS one-loop equation; MOM threshold shown separately; pole is outside perturbative reliability.
scope.quadrature: Adaptive Simpson error estimate is numerical evidence, not a rigorous enclosure.

scope.units: Finite ring uses lattice spacing and k_B T set to one. Four-dimensional loop uses reference momentum Q0=1; the shared mass slider compares two separate models.
scope.gaussian: Exact finite-dimensional Euclidean Gaussian measure for m>0; zero-mean constrained measure is a separately specified model. Odd-site elimination includes determinant and source terms.
